name: Apple iCloud+
priceLabel: Not stated on official site as a privacy price — iCloud+ is priced by storage: 50 GB $0.99/mo, 200 GB $2.99/mo, 2 TB $9.99/mo, 6 TB $29.99/mo, 12 TB $59.99/mo (US, billed monthly)
priceNote: Every iCloud+ tier includes the same privacy features (Private Relay + Hide My Email) — the tiers differ by storage and by HomeKit Secure Video cameras (1 camera on 50 GB, up to 5 on 200 GB / 2 TB, unlimited on 6 TB / 12 TB). Mail Privacy Protection and Safari's tracking prevention are free with the devices. No data-broker removal exists in any Apple plan.

features.label: Broker scan
features.norton: Yes — scans supported people-search & data broker sites and shows which have your data
features.rival: No — Apple offers no data-broker scan

features.label: Automated removal included
features.norton: No — included Privacy Monitor is manual opt-out. Automated removal only with Privacy Monitor Assistant add-on, $109.99/yr or $12.99/mo

features.label: Broker count stated
features.norton: Page by page on norton.com — the Privacy Monitor Assistant product page (us.norton.com/products/privacy-monitor-assistant) says 'over 2,000' data broker sites; the Privacy Monitor feature page (us.norton.com/feature/privacy-monitor) says 'over 200'; the support list names sites individually with no total. Used in this comparison: 'over 2,000' from the Assistant product page on the main site — the Assistant is the removal product. No staging page is used as a source anywhere in this comparison

features.label: Rescan speed
features.norton: Every 90 days (Privacy Monitor Assistant); Privacy Monitor scan re-run every 3 months

features.label: Custom removal requests
features.norton: Offered via Reputation Defender executive/corporate products only (quote-led, 'when possible', no published price, no consumer product): ExecutivePrivacy — “Custom removal requests, when possible”; Total Radius — “Custom Data Removals”; VIP Services — “Deep Web privacy protection, including custom removal requests”. No Norton consumer product offers custom removals — Privacy Monitor Assistant covers its supported broker list only

features.label: Google results removal
features.norton: Yes — via Reputation Defender (separate purchase, reputationdefender.com): “Push negative content or misleading search results down to pages where virtually nobody will ever see them”; its FAQ: “in certain cases online content in your search results can be permanently deleted”. Reputation Defender suppresses negative content in search results and deletes content where possible — it does not make de-indexing requests to Google

features.label: Removal proof
features.norton: Results list + opt-out tracking; email once a batch of opt-outs has been sent. Screenshots: Not stated on official site
features.rival: Safari Privacy Report covers trackers encountered — not broker-removal proof

features.label: Tracker & cookie blocking
features.norton: Yes — Tracker & Cookie Blocking (support). Full ad blocking: Not stated on official site ('limit targeted ads')
features.rival: Yes — Safari Intelligent Tracking Prevention: 'Prevent Cross-Site Tracking: Safari limits third-party cookies and data by default'; iCloud Private Relay stops sites building a profile from your IP / location / browsing history

features.label: Fingerprint protection
features.norton: "Disguise your digital fingerprint automatically each time you browse" — support: anti-fingerprinting will 'return dummy data' to websites
features.rival: Partly — Safari 'presents a simplified version of your system configuration' so your device 'looks more like everyone else's'. A simplified profile — not disguise / randomisation wording

features.label: Email aliases + tracker blocking
features.norton: Yes — create unlimited email aliases (AntiTrack Private Email) and block hidden email trackers
features.rival: Aliases: Yes — Hide My Email: 'Generate unique, random email addresses that automatically forward to your personal inbox' (iCloud+). Email tracker blocking: Yes — Mail Privacy Protection (free) 'prevents senders from seeing if you've opened the email'

features.label: App / OS-level protection
features.norton: Yes — Windows OS Tracker Blocking: blocks tracking activities and targeted ads by the Windows operating system (support)
features.rival: Partly — App Tracking Transparency: apps must ask permission to track you across other companies' apps and websites (iPhone). OS-level tracker blocking: Not stated on official site

features.label: Tracking dashboard
features.norton: Yes — Tracking Dashboard shows real-time blocked trackers, ranked by level of concern / risk
features.rival: Yes — Safari Privacy Report 'shows a summary of trackers that have been encountered and prevented by Intelligent Tracking Prevention'

gaps.detail: Norton states no home-security-camera video product. (Checked SafeCam — webcam protection on Windows PCs, not home cameras — and all 360/LifeLock pages.)

gaps.detail: Norton states no sign-in-with-provider identity product. (Checked Password Manager and all LifeLock/360 pages — no sign-in-with-provider service stated.)

nortonEvidence.note: Windows/Mac only; part of a paid Norton add-on.
nortonEvidence.quote: Create unlimited email aliases and block hidden email trackers, all without changing your current provider (Windows, Mac).

partials.detail: Norton Password Manager stores passwords and has 2FA for vault login; passkeys and verification codes are stated for Apple's Passwords app but not stated for Norton. (Apple's compromised-password alerts are covered separately by LifeLock Dark Web Monitoring.)

nortonEvidence.note: Free standalone; included in Norton 360 tiers and VPN Ultimate; blog feature list: 'Passwordless vault unlock, safety dashboard, password generator'; no email aliases; passkeys/2FA authenticator not stated.

Two-Factor Authentication helps stop cybercriminals from accessing your info by adding another layer of security when you log in to Password Manager to make sure it's really you.

partials.detail: Norton Cloud Backup stores secure copies of files (2 GB-500 GB by tier, Windows only) - backup, not a photo/file sync drive.

nortonEvidence.note: RE-CHECK 12 Nov 2026: 2 GB (AntiVirus Plus/Standard) to 250 GB+ (360 with LifeLock; Ultimate Plus 500 GB); Windows only (plan-page footnote 4); backup, not a general cloud drive.
nortonEvidence.quote: Store important files, photos, and documents in the cloud, and easily recover them if your device is lost, stolen, or crashes.

partials.rivalHowSold: Free 5 GB; iCloud+ tiers by storage
partials.rivalPrice: Free 5 GB; iCloud+ 50 GB $0.99/mo, 200 GB $2.99/mo, 2 TB $9.99/mo, 6 TB $29.99/mo, 12 TB $59.99/mo (US, billed monthly)

nortonEvidence.note: Scam scanning, not email tracker blocking; 360 with LifeLock tiers only (Scam Protection Pro).
